title: Replacement character in source text indicates encoding corruption
description: Flags U+FFFD replacement character in source files. This usually indicates broken decode/encode round-trips and is a strong early warning of parser drift, mojibake, or data loss.
detection_method: Regex scan for Unicode replacement char literal
preventionRule: After automated rewrites, verify file bytes and parser health. Avoid lossy decode paths; keep UTF-8 with BOM for Unicode-heavy PS files in PS5.1 workflows.
remedy: 1) Restore from known-good backup when possible. 2) Re-decode using the original encoding path and save as UTF-8 with BOM. 3) Run PS5 ParseFile() check after repair.
